digest.component_or_area: LLM usage logging and repetition detection
propositions: max_consecutive_repeat metric only detects adjacent identical tool call signatures and misses cycles of length >= 2, scoring a genuine 4-call cycle as 1 while healthy breadth runs score higher

the windowed distinct-ratio computed over trailing 24 tool calls (set cardinality divided by window size) detects all cycle lengths including k-cycles and separates pathological loops from healthy runs with a wide margin using trip threshold <= 0.50
distinct_ratio_window field must report None when fewer than 24 signatures exist to prevent false positives on short all-identical prefixes that would trip at call 2

REPETITION_WINDOW and REPETITION_TRIP_RATIO must be module-level named constants exported from usage_log.py for three consumers (summary producer, c827 actuator, aec1 recorder) to share one definition
the new distinct_ratio_window signal is additive to existing counters and must not change the sidecar contract or privacy guarantees (arguments remain hashed)
